title: Mystery Crate
description: A rarer purple airdrop crate that rolls one of three when you pop it: an instant +3 levels, a screen-wide shockwave, or a random weapon.

title: Liquidation Risk: Leverage evolves
description: Stack Leverage 5 times and every crit arcs to a second bear, but each hit you take flashes the screen red and costs 10% more.

title: Honeypot
description: A new trap: a pile of gold candles that looks like free XP snaps shut when you walk in and holds you for a second while the bears close in.
